comparison.objective: Install a spin-on oil filter to a prescribed post-contact rotation/torque without loosening, over-tightening, or damaging its gasket.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial cylindrical grasp, controlled threaded rotation, wrist regrasping, and torque/angle control; some versions add cap-wrench handling.
comparison.success_condition: Filter finishes within the allowed angle band past gasket contact, never exceeds damage limits or comes off-thread, and is released; versions specify partial angle bands and a 1 s dwell. No material-separation or recovery requirement.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests pouring and orientation-dependent screening of many free bodies, bridge clearing, selective retention, and spill control. Oil-filter threading and torque control are meaningfully different abilities.
